messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
["Soon, we'll be adding enhanced online security-and we want you to know what to expect.", "we've temporarily limited what you can do with your account until the issue is resolved.", 'To address this, Standard Bank has released a 128-bit SSL update for the online banking page that eliminates this bug.', 'Halifax is proud to announce to you the new update in the security of our online SSL Servers.', 'Thank you for providing us with an updated email address, richard@highwayman.com', 'YOUR ACCOUNT HAS BEEN LIMITED !', 'We noticed unusual activity on your account', 'our record indicates that you are eligible to receive a tax refund of 370.00 GBP.', 'Either your information has been changed or incomplete, as a result your access to use our services has been limited.', 'Your shipment is scheduled for delivery tomorrow.', "You've sent a payment for 89.95 GPB to John Austin.", 'We’ll send a confirmation when your items ship.', 'To get back in to your account use get started button below.', 'Our Security department has blocked your account remote service.', 'You have an unconfirmed payment on your account.', 'TOTAL $4.08']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We provide updates about account security, access restrictions, unusual activity, payments, refunds, shipments, and steps to resolve or confirm account matters."}
